text:
lina_cs: Heads-up — CobaltRetail just told Kevin they want to roll our personalization recommender to a second org (merchandising) and a new real-time use case for in-store kiosks. They expect ~200–300 qps at peak per region starting next month.

kevin_ae: Nice upsell signal. Do we know which models/pipelines they'll use? Is this more embedding lookups or full generation?

lina_cs: They said the existing session-based ranker for web will be reused for candidate scoring, but the kiosk flow will call a compact generation model for 1–2 short completions per interaction. So mix of embed + small gen.

aj_solutions: Ok can you get expected token counts? qps alone doesn't give cost/latency. Also need SLA ask from merch team — they want <120ms p95.

lina_cs: I asked Tyler at Cobalt for a traffic sample, here's their estimate: avg session 18 tokens, completion ~30 tokens, 220 qps peak, 3 regions (NA/EU/APAC) with burst windows during store open hours.

marta_eng: 120ms p95 for gen + retrieval at 220 qps per region is tight on shared hosted. We should propose either a Dedicated reserved pool or a hybrid: Dedicated for kiosks + Hosted for background scoring.

aj_solutions: Agree. Also flag potential renewal risk if we can't guarantee latency for the merch team pilot — they're evaluating ROI. Lina, can CS coordinate a runbook walkthrough and a gating checklist with Eng?

lina_cs: Yep. I can run an enablement session next Wed. Can Eng produce an initial capacity estimate and a quick cost delta for Dedicated?

marta_eng: I can do a first-pass. Need sample traffic patterns and sequence length distribution. Also need to know if they want KV-cache enabled for the ranker.

kevin_ae: I already asked for the logs. Tyler said they'd share a 24h sample by EOD today.

onboarding-bot: Created ticket CS-4821: "CobaltRetail merchandising expansion — capacity and enablement" assigned to @marta_eng and @aj_solutions. Priority: High.

marta_eng: Great. Once I have logs I’ll run a quick sim and post numbers — looking at Dedicated recommendation + suggested autoscale headroom.

lina_cs: Next steps: 1) Kevin to collect sample logs (EOD). 2) Marta run sim and post recommended config (48h). 3) Lina schedule enablement + success criteria call (next Wed). 4) AJ draft Dedicated proposal and price delta. Tagging this as expansion opportunity and potential renewal hinge. :eyes:

aj_solutions: I'll draft the proposal and include a short pilot timeline. If Eng's numbers show Dedicated is needed, we should include a short-term reserved commit for the kiosk pilot.

marta_eng: Preliminary ask: if Dedicated, we may need 2x of our standard G4-pool per region for safe headroom at 220 qps with KV cache disabled; with cache it's 1x. I'll confirm after the sim.

lina_cs: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll loop in CSM exec and schedule the enablement invite once Marta confirms.

aj_solutions: tagging @kevin_ae for reminders.

kevin_ae: Got it. Will push for the logs today.

marta_eng: Posting follow-up here when sim is done.

lina_cs: closing loop for now — keeping this as "expansion - high priority" in our tracker. :rocket:
